title: Circuit boards for the repair of our outpost CLTV Outpost GSC-0044: 60 boards of the pilot's own storage at Node Beta put into the faction's storage at the outpost; members of the faction only
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-21 20:15 UTC, beside supply-repair-gsc-0044-plate (its note says why): the two damaged facilities ask about 45 circuit boards at 30% of their build materials (bunker 100, Lockbox 50 in the catalog); one hauler stores 480 boards at Node Beta (table holdings, 19:52 UTC), so `requires.stored` 60 there sends only that pilot. One load, `once` with `max_pilots` 1; what the repairs leave stays in the faction's storage at the outpost for its next build.
